title: Introducing Theatre.Reviews With Paul Seven
transcript: I've been in love with theater since I was a child I worked in theater for over 20 years and I reviewed theater for a while in the guardian and the stage now I want people to share my enjoyment of theater but I'm aware there are a lot of shows to choose from and it's not cheap so in my reviews I use my experience to describe the writing the production and the performances and to give a few insights and my opinion if you enjoy what you see please like comment and subscribe
classificationReason: Channel introduction video — no specific production is reviewed or discussed. Creator describes their background and reviewing approach in general terms.
